title: [Feature Request] Make `#[serde(rename_all = "")]` support independent number
author: TheCGDF
body_preview: For exampe, current snake case: ```rust #[derive(Serialize)] #[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")] pub enum Chapter {     Have1Apple, // will be "have1_apple" } ```  Hope something can do this: ```rust #[derive(Serialize)] #[serde(rename_all = "snake_case", independent_number = true)] pub enum Chapter {     Have1Apple, // want to be "have_1_apple" } ```
